## Librerías 

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(raster)
library(ntbox)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dismo)
library(terra)

```

## Variables 

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(terra)

setwd("D:/2026_ENM/Centralidad/vars")
vars <- list.files(pattern = ".tif")
vars <- rast(vars)
plot(vars)

```

## Registros de presencia 

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

gbif <- read.csv("D:/2026_ENM/Centralidad/A_mon.csv")
head(gbif)

data <- extract(vars, gbif[, c(1:2)], df = TRUE)
data <- cbind(gbif, data[c(-1)])
head(data)

```

## Hipótesis M

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(terra)

jjm <- vect("D:/2026_ENM/Calibracion/ecoreg/Ecoregions2017.shp")
occ1 <- gbif
occ2 <- vect(as.matrix(occ1), type = "points", crs = "EPSG:4326")
jjm_subset <- jjm[occ2, ] 
ecor <- aggregate(jjm_subset)
ecor_M <- crop(vars, ecor, mask = TRUE)
plot(ecor_M[[1]])
plot(ecor, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)
points(occ1, pch = 3)

```

## Construir elipsoides

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(ntbox)
library(raster)
library(rgl)
#library(devtools)
#install_github("cran/rglwidget")
library(rglwidget)

M <- as.data.frame(as.points(ecor_M[[1:3]], values = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE))
proj <- as.data.frame(as.points(vars[[1:3]], values = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE))
idx <- sample(nrow(proj), min(10000, nrow(proj)))

ecor_M <- raster::stack(ecor_M)
covar_centroid <- cov_center(data, mve = TRUE, level = 0.95, vars = c(3:5))
ellipsoidMod <- ellipsoidfit(ecor_M[[1:3]], covar_centroid$centroid, covar_centroid$covariance, level = 0.95, plot = FALSE, size = 1, alpha = 0.2)

ellipsoid_95 <- ellipse3d(covar_centroid$covariance, centre = covar_centroid$centroid, level = 0.95)
rgl::wire3d(ellipsoid_95, col = "red", add = TRUE)
rgl::points3d(M[, c(1:3)], size = 0.5, col = "black", alpha = 0.7, add = TRUE)
rgl::points3d(proj[idx, c(1:3)], size = 3, col = "grey", alpha = 0.7, add = TRUE)
rgl::points3d(data[, c(3:5)], size = 10, col = "red", add = TRUE)
box3d(col = "black")
rglwidget::rglwidget()

plot(ellipsoidMod$suitRaster)
points(data[, c(1:2)])

```

## Comparar mis abundancias 

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

knitr::include_graphics("D:/2026_ENM/Centralidad/asmaf_data.jpg",dpi = 150)

```

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

abund <- read.csv("D:/2026_ENM/Centralidad/ab_A_mon.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
loc <- read.csv("D:/2026_ENM/Centralidad/Localities.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

head(abund)
head(loc)

df_merge <- na.omit(merge(abund, loc, by = "SampleID", all.x = TRUE, all.y = TRUE))
head(df_merge)
ab_data <- raster::extract(ellipsoidMod$suitRaster, df_merge[, c(6:5)])

cor_data <- cbind(df_merge[, 4], ab_data)
cor_data <- na.omit(cor_data)
colnames(cor_data) <- c("abun", "DNC")
cor_data <- as.data.frame(cor_data)
cor_data$DNC <- 1-cor_data$DNC
head(cor_data)

```

## Visualizamos

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dismo)

formula <- y ~ poly(x, 2, raw = TRUE)

ggplot(cor_data, aes(DNC, abun)) +
  geom_point(shape = 1, size = 1, color = "black") +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", cor.coef.name = "rho", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") +
  labs(x = "DNC", y = "Abundance") +
  geom_smooth(color = "red", method = "lm", formula = formula, se = TRUE) +
  stat_regline_equation(aes(label =  paste(after_stat(eq.label), sep = "~~~~")), formula = formula, label.y = 450) +
  theme_bw()

```

# Simulaciones de dispersión / Modelos dinámicos de distribución de especies

# bam

Dynamic Distribution Modeling using the BAM scheme

$$ G_{j}(t + 1) = B_{j}(t)A_{j}(t)C_{j}Gj(t) $$

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

knitr::include_graphics("D:/2026_ENM/Centralidad/bam.jpg",dpi = 150)

```

### Calcular la simulación 

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval = FALSE}

#if (!require('devtools')) install.packages('devtools')
#devtools::install_github('luismurao/bam')
library(bam)
library(raster)

model <- ellipsoidMod$suitRaster
sparse_mod <- bam::model2sparse(model,threshold = 0.05)
adj_mod <- bam::adj_mat(sparse_mod, ngbs = 1)
occs_sparse <- bam::occs2sparse(modelsparse = sparse_mod, occs = gbif)

sdm_300 <- bam::sdm_sim(set_A = sparse_mod,
                            set_M = adj_mod,
                            initial_points = occs_sparse,
                            nsteps = 300,
                            stochastic_dispersal = TRUE,
                            disp_prop2_suitability = TRUE,
                            disper_prop = 0.5,
                            progress_bar = TRUE)

```

### Animación

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval = FALSE}

anim3 <- "D:/2026_ENM/Centralidad/anim.html"

g_300 <- sim2Animation(
  sdm_simul = sdm_100,
  which_steps = seq(1, 100, by = 1),
  fmt = "html",
  filename = anim3,
  bg_color = "#F6F2E5",
  suit_color = "#F6F2E5",
  occupied_color = "#03C33F",
  gif_vel = 0.5,
  ani.width = 1200,
  ani.height = 1200)

```
